## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      17 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 20 abr 2026 - 9 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _User1opj_, 9 oct 2026, 1/5: "If I had not used it in writing notes in Mac already, I would never used it in my iPad cause the app here is disappointing for the following reasons This app is difficult to use as a note taken in IOS : - Always lagging - when I try to type using iPad keyboard I can’t see what I am writing cause the page will scroll down every single time - not apple pencil friendly, text difficult to recognize (when I try to select words[writing and editing using it is something I had long since learned that they will never fix it{) - AI support is not optimum in iPad, whenever I will use it the app will lag and I need to close it and reopen to continue my notes taken - can not search in the page alone - I can not change the color of any text , it will immediately lag , and do not apply the color changes - difficult to move text Keep in mind I am using a new empty page !!!"
            2. _AndrewLuisBox_, 7 oct 2026, 1/5: "Too slow and waste my time and always asked money ."
            3. _emilie_hys_, 1 oct 2026, 1/5: "Ça marchais vraiment bien mais maintenant toute l’application bug, je pouvais facilement changer les couleurs de ‘écriture en appuyant sur les points au bord de la ligne/du paragraphe mais ça ne marche plus. de plus dès que je tente d’écrire une lettre cela remonte mon texte ce qui fait que je ne peux pas voir ce que j’écris..; C’est dommage c’était super avant ca"
